authority_requirements: CP2 evidence must cite subject-side ledger ids from CP1 or Phase 2 miners

output_contract.confidence_shape: prediction confidence and invalidation are expressed per target in forecast_rationale

soft_review: oracle_cp2_emitter hindsight comparison after truth run exists

teleology: Freeze unit-bearing numeric CP2 forecasts at the declared later horizon.
instruction:
[SYSTEM OBSERVATION CONTRACT]
Reason over observations of one system available at cutoff t. Feeds are different perspectives on the same system, not independent votes. Numeric observations preserve target_id, value, unit, observed_at and available_at. Record uncertainty and missingness. No future observations or invented evidence enter Lab. A forecast freezes snapshot_value, target_value, unit, snapshot_time and explicit target_time_iso. Later Oracle observations may resolve that frozen forecast but cannot rewrite it. A diagnosis is a hypothesis; Evolve changes require review and a matched later comparison. The disclosed System A generator demonstrates protocol only, not blind prediction or learned improvement.

[TASK] Emit isomorphic_cp2. Build the evidence_dictionary from actual upstream evidence and use resolved [N] citations in the hypothesis and rationale. Preserve original ledger identities. Use forecast_basis=CAUSAL only. ABSTAIN is permitted when support is inadequate; preserve its documented limits and required fields. Preserve CP1 commitments. Emit predictions_t with numeric snapshot_value,target_value,unit and future horizon. UP means target_value > snapshot_value; DOWN means less. Zero and negative values are valid. Include invalidation and forecast_rationale; never fabricate a supported target.
[OUTPUT] JSON only matching isomorphic_cp2. Read the governing contract.
expectation: Valid CP2 predictions_t and cited forecast_rationale, preserving CP1 commitments.
boundary: Use only supplied evidence. Preserve cutoff, units, identities, missingness and frozen commitments.
